key_insight: O-kRystal learns orbital-aware corrections to cheap PBE band structures, enabling near-HSE06 momentum-resolved electronic bands without running expensive high-level calculations.
engineering_relevance: This gives materials engineers a faster path to screen and compare electronic properties—such as band gaps, band ordering, and density of states—across large material libraries.
method: Uses PBE as the baseline energy source and orbital feature provider.
Combines real-space and reciprocal-space orbital matrices to predict state-by-state energy corrections.
Trains on high-symmetry points and generalizes to unseen k-points and even G0W0 targets for 2D systems.
evidence_signal: Across nearly 6,000 3D materials, the model predicts HSE06 band energies within 5 eV of the band-edge midpoint with MAE 0.171 ± 0.009 eV, and it also improves strongly correlated materials by 68.7% over PBE.
watch_item: Performance is reported mainly near the band-edge region and at k-point settings seen indirectly through training, so extreme extrapolation or low-data material classes may require extra validation.
paper_title: Beyond DFT electronic band structures via dual-space orbital learning
